response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack and systems developer with strong backend, distributed-systems, and DevOps skills, but his career has centered almost entirely on web technologies (TypeScript/Node.js, JavaScript, DLang) with only brief, dated C/C++ exposure (2014-2015 at National Instruments). He shows no evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, MQTT, message brokers, or industrial-automation/IoT protocol experience required for this role, making him a poor match despite strong general engineering ability.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level software engineering experience (15+ years)
Strong background in distributed systems, low-latency and high-throughput services
Demonstrated mentoring, workshop facilitation, and technical communication skills
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (less than 1 year, over a decade ago)
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity expertise
No demonstrated experience with MQTT, REST-based IoT systems, or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, etc.)

key_factors.factor: Strong general distributed-systems and engineering seniority
